{{Top|leg}}
'''Motivational processors''' were part of a [[Droid/Legends|droid's]] internal mechanisms, controlling a droid's behavior. [[Restraining bolt/Legends|Restraining bolts]] were attached to the motivational processor, which then allowed a droid to be controlled by commands sent from a [[Droid caller/Legends|caller]].<ref name="CFTD">''[[Cynabar's Fantastic Technology: Droids]]''</ref>
